Tara (Finance): Heads up  GCP settlement ingestion skipped a batch for reseller 'EdgeScale Partners' on 2026-04-10. Partner noticed underbilling on three days and asked for a corrective credit.
Ben (Billing Ops): Can you paste the deltas? Ill check the ingestion logs and the BigQuery loader.
Tara (Finance): Quick export: 
```
reseller,day,expected_usd,ingested_usd,delta_usd
EdgeScale,2026-04-08,950,0,950
EdgeScale,2026-04-09,1100,0,1100
EdgeScale,2026-04-10,400,0,400
TOTAL,,2450,0,2450
```
Tara (Finance): GCP case opened: 02-895678. Partner is pushing for a credit this week because their renewal invoicing is scheduled.
Maya (Accounting): For provisional credits >$2k we need manager approval and a memo. Book to contra-revenue 4201 and prepare reversing entry template.
Ibrahim (Partner Success): Partner prefers offset on their May invoice vs separate refund. They can accept internal credit if documented.
gcp-marketplace-bot: Alert: ingestion gap detected for project edgescale-prod on 2026-04-10. Case 02-895678 opened.
Ben (Billing Ops): I'll re-run the loader and look for dropped partitions. If it's our loader fault we can do immediate correction and issue internal credit. If it's upstream, we must wait for GCP memo.
Tara (Finance): Proposal: provisional offset up to $3,000 to be applied to May invoice, pending GCP confirmation. Attach GCP case and partner ack, and add 10-business-day follow-up.
Maya (Accounting): I approve the accounting treatment once manager signs off. GL 4201 and tag 'marketplace-reseller'.
Ben (Billing Ops): Created FIN ticket FIN-3221 with logs and export: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3221. Added automated follow-up in 10 business days.
Ibrahim (Partner Success): Sent partner confirmation: "We will apply a $2,450 offset to your May invoice while GCP investigates. We will reverse if GCP issues a credit." Partner replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick help."
Tara (Finance): Manager approval requested; will update thread when granted.
Maya (Accounting): Manager approved provisional offset up to $3k. Approve: Lina +1.
Tara (Finance): Applied provisional offset in AR and closed loop. Will reverse on GCP memo or finalize on confirmation. Thread closed. :white_check_mark:
